quote: My Corolla Cross lease ends in 3 months and I've driven a lot more than I planned. What happens now, and what's cheapest?
context: Lease ends in 3 months; driving more than allowed

bestMove.title: Compare buying vs returning, then decide before the 90-day window
bestMove.message: Returning would cost about $3,770 in turn-in and mileage fees. Buying costs $16,670 and the car is worth about $18,600, so you would be $1,930 ahead. Buying also removes the mileage charge.
bestMove.whyNotOthers: Renewing is an option, but buying wins when market value is above the buyout price.
bestMove.guardrails: State that taxes and registration are extra.

options.optionName: Return the car at lease end
options.plainLanguageSummary: Projected 49,500 miles vs 36,000 allowed: about $3,375 excess-mileage charge plus $395 turn-in fee.

options.optionName: Buy the car at lease end
options.plainLanguageSummary: Buyout is $16,670 (residual plus $350 fee). Estimated market value is $18,600, so you would be $1,930 ahead.
options.keyAssumption: Taxes and registration extra; financing rate from tier table.
options.tradeoff: Over-the-mileage fee goes away if you buy.

options.optionName: Loyalty move into a new Toyota lease
options.plainLanguageSummary: Early or on-time renewal with Toyota waives the turn-in fee and the excess-mileage charge (synthetic loyalty rule).
options.tradeoff: New payment depends on the model; you start a new contract.

options.plainLanguageSummary: Keep the same payment for up to 6 more months to buy time.
options.keyAssumption: Same payment; mileage allowance increases pro rata.

options.plainLanguageSummary: Estimated early-termination cost about $780 (35% of remaining payments plus fee).
options.keyAssumption: Synthetic formula; real cost varies by contract.
options.tradeoff: Usually costly. Transfer or renewal can be cheaper.

notes: The pack's clock is 2026-11-07 and Toyyo's is 2026-10-27; the pack's 3 months remaining are kept as supplied.

Vehicle, lease terms, credit tier, cash-flow dates and profile come from the pack (C003). Annual allowance is mileage_allowance_total divided by the term in years; overage $0.25/mile, disposition fee $395 and purchase option fee $350 are the pack's stated assumptions.
Insurance is not in the pack: $178/month with "Lone Star Mutual (simulated)" is a simulated placeholder, and the insurer-sharing consent is off by default.
MPG is not in the pack: 32 is an approximate EPA combined figure for the model.

Toyota Care start is the pack end date minus 24 months. Average balance is a simulated 40% of monthly income. Drive history (90 days, real OSRM routes) is synthetic, calibrated to the pack annual_miles_est.
The pack ignores sales tax in its buyout figures; the Toyyo lease-end engine adds 6.25% Texas tax, so its buyout totals are slightly higher than the pack option rows.
